say:2:1534414003:1.text: Not convinced? Fine. Some are born to strive. Others are born to nap. Eating and sleeping are universal laws, and you're just following nature.
say:2:1534414003:1.source_cn: 怎么，这个回答还不够吗？有人天生喜欢奋斗，当然也有人天...

narration:3:1534414004:1.text: At last, it all makes sense. Sleep. Sleep until the end of time...

narration:4:1534414005:1.text:
In dreams, problems melt away. In dreams, maybe even your future waits for you.
Good night, Esperia.
